sloka: पुष्योत्सवसमृद्धा च नष्टभर्त्री सराक्षसा ।भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का नष्टभर्त्री यथाङ्गना ।। ५.२४.२८।।।।
transliteration: puṣyotsavasamṛddhā ca naṣṭabhartrī sarākṣasā ।bhaviṣyati purī laṅkā naṣṭabhartrī yathāṅganā ।। 5.24.28।।।।

translations.english: Now Vikata another ogress with hanging breasts raised her fist up in anger and roared at Sita.
